description: Centrais Elétricas - Região Autónoma dos Açores (RAA) is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Power Plants of the Autonomous Region of the Azores. Vector mapping produced at scale 1: 5 000 based on the catalogue of power plants of the Autonomous Region of the Azores available on the website of the Electricity Museum. Coverage: Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . The portal shows the English title as "Power Plants - Autonomous Region of the Azores (RAA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Secretaria Regional do Ambiente e Ação Climática / Governo dos Açores . Its keywords include sao-miguel, outra-cartografia, pico, centrais-eletricas, portugal, sraac-gra. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
